components.name: Primary Action Pill
components.description: Solid graphite pill button for major conversion triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background-color: #1C1D20; color: #ffffff; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #000000; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Secondary Architectural Button
components.description: Clean bordered button resting softly on warm stone surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: transparent; color: #1a1a1e; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #1a1a1e; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Form Text Input
components.description: Pill text input with subtle border and focused ring.
components.html: <input type="text" class="ds-input" placeholder="Tu nombre o empresa..." />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; max-width: 420px; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10); color: #1a1a1e; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1C1D20; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #1C1D20; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }

components.name: Telemetry Status Chip
components.description: Monospaced status tag with live emerald indicator dot.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.70); letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: #00C988; }

components.name: Editorial Specification Row
components.description: Two-column editorial specification row with hairline division.
components.html:
Carga instantánea sub-segundo

components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr; gap: 32px; padding: 36px 16px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); } .ds-row-title { font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 400; color: #000000; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-row-body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75); max-width: 58ch; }

narrative.overview: JP Studios embodies the discipline of Dennis Snellenberg, Locomotive, and Pentagram: high-density editorial craft where typography, white space, and interaction physics lead the experience. The interface does not decorate; it builds structural confidence. Monolithic scale contrast anchors the visual identity, allowing monumental display type to command the viewport while restrained telemetry anchors orientation.
keyCharacteristics: Pure solid graphite surfaces (#1C1D20) with zero artificial noise or fake grain
Hardware-accelerated physical inertia with virtual smooth scrolling and magnetic pull
Dignified editorial rhythm: zero patronizing scroll indicators, zero filler copy

rules.name: The Anti-All-Caps Rule
rules.body: Display headlines and navigation must strictly default to natural Title Case or Sentence case. Never force headings into uppercase.

rules.name: The Slender Weight Mandate
rules.body: Monumental headlines must use light or normal weights (300/400). Reserve bold weights strictly for intentional micro-accents.

rules.name: The Pure Solid Surface Rule
rules.body: Dark themes and footers must use rich, pure solid graphite (#1C1D20). Never inject SVG grain, feTurbulence noise, or dirty radial gradients.

rules.name: The Anti-Card Rule
rules.body: Cards are lazy containers. Avoid nesting cards inside cards. Rely on architectural white space and hairlines instead of boxed cards.

dos: Do use natural Title Case for headlines and display text
Do use hairline borders (rgba(0,0,0,0.08)) and generous architectural whitespace
Do synchronize GSAP ScrollTrigger with Lenis virtual scroll
Do respect the user's intelligence with zero patronizing scroll prompts
donts: Don't force headings into ALL CAPS
Don't use artificial grain or SVG noise overlays
Don't use cliché AI landing page tropes (purple radial glows, sparkle badges)
